subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue close with a larger fixed initial history window, or should closure require Control UI load-older pagination using the existing chat.history offset contract?
rationale: Both approaches expose more history, but the fixed-window PR changes the default startup payload while pagination matches the existing backend contract and avoids making every session load larger.

options.title: Require Load-Older Pagination
options.body: Keep the initial history request bounded and close the issue only after Control UI can fetch older pages on demand.

options.title: Accept Fixed Window After Proof
options.body: Allow the linked 500-message mitigation to close the issue after maintainers accept the payload tradeoff and the PR lands.

recommendation.title: Require Load-Older Pagination
recommendation.body: Keep the initial history request bounded and close the issue only after Control UI can fetch older pages on demand.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has adjacent Control UI chat-history provenance and is the best available owner for the UX/performance tradeoff.
